official_metadata.official_description: A battle-scarred Korean fishing village featuring abandoned military tanks, burning residential structures, narrow alleyways, building interiors, a boathouse, wooden docks, and shallow water traversal.
official_metadata.provenance: Activision / Infinity Ward Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Official Intel

cut_the_cake_suitability.analysis_notes: Cut the Cake Inference: Multi-level balconies and elevated boathouse perches create vertical firing lines that challenge pure 2D planar raycasting.
